title: Fix useDesignAppSelection Runtime Reference Error
description: Fix runtime error "Uncaught ReferenceError: useDesignAppSelection is not defined" at sketchpad index.tsx line 29247. The function is defined at line 29631 but referenced at line 29247 in module-scope code. Need to investigate why function hoisting isn't working and fix the issue.
summary: The useDesignAppSelection function is properly defined at line 29631 as an export function declaration (hoisted) and correctly referenced at line 29247. The rewind operation restored it. Also fixed Playwright/chromium-bidi dependency optimization errors by adding @playwright/test, playwright, and playwright-core to optimizeDeps.exclude in vite.config.ts. All 114 unit tests pass. Dev server starts cleanly.
